_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante : Systems & software (coeur hardware metrology + AI), revenue total, parts revenue (recurrent), services revenue (recurrent), gross margin (qualite).

kpis.signal: Coeur metier 86% du CA, hypercroissance 2024 portee par Dragonfly + advanced packaging AI
kpis.description_fr: Ventes de systemes metrology / inspection (Atlas, Dragonfly) + logiciels. Coeur hardware ONTO. Rebond 2024 grace a demande packaging chips IA (HBM, advanced packaging).
kpis.description_en: Sales of metrology / inspection systems (Atlas, Dragonfly) + software. Core ONTO hardware. 2024 rebound driven by AI chip packaging demand (HBM, advanced packaging).

kpis.signal: Quasi-doublement vs 2020, rebond AI 2024 apres creux memoire 2023
kpis.description_fr: CA consolide ONTO Innovation. Cycle semi : pic 2022 (1.0Md$), creux memoire 2023, rebond 2024 dope par advanced packaging IA et HBM.
kpis.description_en: ONTO Innovation consolidated revenue. Semi cycle: 2022 peak (1.0Bn$), memory trough 2023, 2024 rebound driven by AI advanced packaging and HBM.

kpis.signal: Marge brute >50%, marqueur de qualite cycle vs concurrents semi-cap
kpis.description_fr: Marge brute consolidee. % marge : 50% (2020), 54% (2021), 53.6% (2022), 51.5% (2023), 52.2% (2024). Maintien >50% en bas de cycle = qualite pricing power.
kpis.description_en: Consolidated gross profit. Margin %: 50% (2020), 54% (2021), 53.6% (2022), 51.5% (2023), 52.2% (2024). Holding >50% in cycle trough = pricing power quality marker.

kpis.signal: Profitabilite x6.5 en 5 ans, rebond AI 2024 quasi au niveau pic 2022
kpis.description_fr: Resultat net GAAP. Sensibilite forte au cycle (creux 2023 -46% vs 2022). EPS dilue 2024 = 4.06$ vs 2.46$ en 2023.
kpis.description_en: GAAP net income. Strong cycle sensitivity (2023 trough -46% vs 2022). 2024 diluted EPS = $4.06 vs $2.46 in 2023.

kpis.signal: Recurrent (~14% CA), proxy installed base, plus stable que systems
kpis.description_fr: Spare parts + services / contrats maintenance + upgrades. Tres lie a l'utilisation usine clients. Bien plus stable que les systems (cycle).
kpis.description_en: Spare parts + service / maintenance contracts + upgrades. Tied to customer fab utilization. Far more stable than systems (cycle).

kpis_story: ONTO Innovation = pure-play semi-cap metrology + inspection. Issue de la fusion Rudolph + Nanometrics (2019). Trois moteurs : Atlas (metrology advanced nodes), Dragonfly (inspection advanced packaging IA / HBM), lithography back-end. Cycle 2020-2024 : 556M$ -> 1005M$ (pic 2022) -> 816M$ (creux memoire 2023) -> 987M$ (rebond IA 2024). Marge brute robuste >50% sur tout le cycle.
_notes: Fiscal years ONTO : FY2020 termine 26 dec 2020 (52 sem), FY2021 termine 1 jan 2022 (53 sem), FY2022 termine 31 dec 2022, FY2023 termine 30 dec 2023, FY2024 termine 28 dec 2024. History FY2020-2024 cinq ans pleins.
